source_text.body:
Refine product picks and watch saved pages for sales
In a two-day test, Dots refined couch suggestions from preferences and monitored saved product pages for sales; a subscription cancellation stalled at a CAPTCHA.
·
Oct 7, 2026
Done with
DO
Dots
What they did
The tester asked Dots to research couches. It returned a three-page packet with four options, and he and his partner disliked them. He then added color and pull-out bed preferences and asked for 10 options ranked with a point-based rubric. He saved some links, and Dots was asked to monitor those product pages for sales.
How it went
The revised suggestions moved closer to the stated preferences, and page monitoring was set up. He did not report buying a couch. A separate subscription cancellation failed at a puzzle CAPTCHA, and Dots asked him to handle it.
Worth knowing
This is one tester's two-day account, not a reliability measure. CAPTCHAs can still halt the agent, so expect to step in on cancellations.
Try it yourself
with
Dots
Copy prompt
I'm shopping for [product type, e.g. a couch] with a budget of [amount], and my preferences are [size, color, material, deal-breakers]. Give me 3 to 5 picks with prices and links, ask me follow-up questions to narrow them, and then watch the product pages I choose and message me when any go on sale or drop below [target price]. Do not buy or cancel anything without showing me the details first and getting my approval. If a site blocks you with a CAPTCHA, tell me instead of retrying.
Original source: https://www.neoteo.com/en/a-reported-openai-dots-test-finds-useful-follow-up-and-a-hard-stop
